experiments.hypothesis: A source-bound retrieval surface may help visitors inspect records without converting records into causal claims about their own sites.
experiments.firstUserOutcome: Enter a query/filter over source-bound records with explicit empty and error states.
experiments.metric: Unmeasured filter-to-record completion after 10 observed non-synthetic sessions.
experiments.stopRule: <30% after 10 sessions retires or reframes the experiment.
experiments.noDataBoundary: No data means no demand or revenue conclusion.
experiments.blockedBy: Coordinator-owned shared renderer/static-build/CSP adapter; public functional surface is not shipped.
experiments.nextSafeAction: Keep the experiment specification and regression gate current; await coordinator-owned adapter authority before implementing a public surface.
